subject: Bentwood benchmarking kickoff and results exchange
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@bentwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bentwood benchmarking kickoff: test plan and targets

Hi Olivia / Bentwood team,

As discussed on the call, attached is the Redwood test-plan we'll run for onboarding benchmarking. High-level targets for acceptance: 
- Functional model variant: rwd-large (8-bit quant)
- Single-request latency (generation, 256-token prompt -> 64-token completion): p95 <= 200 ms, p99 <= 600 ms
- Sustained throughput target: 100-120 RPS for concurrent inference profile A (user-facing short prompts)
- Concurrency profile B (batch inference for analytics): 400 concurrent requests for 20m soak
- Error rate: <0.5% 5xx across runs

Test harness: we'll run a k6-based load script (attached: load-script.k6.js) against your dedicated test slice in us-west-2. We'll perform a 10-minute warmup + three 20-minute measurement windows. We'll seed the run with your prompt set (please confirm the attached bentwood-prompt-set.csv).

Observability and artifacts we will share: aggregated latency histograms (p50/p95/p99), per-instance CPU/GPU utilization, KV-cache hit statistics, error traces, and raw request logs (sanitized PII). We'll upload CSVs and a short run summary to the shared Drive link.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the test window — we propose Fri, Mar 29 02:00-06:00 UTC (local overnight) for minimal production impact.
2) Confirm the prompt set and any additional traffic shaping (ratelimits, burst controls).
3) Provide a short-lived API key and endpoint for the dedicated test slice (we'll rotate creds after the run).

If these targets look good, Monica and I will run the soak on Friday and share results + action items within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bentwood-test-plan.pdf (summary), load-script.k6.js (k6 scenario)

Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bentwood benchmarking kickoff: test plan and targets

Thanks Ben — we can run the window you suggested (Fri, Mar 29 02:00-06:00 UTC). A few clarifications before you run:

- Warmup: please plan for a 10m warmup, then 5m of ramp to steady state before the measurement windows.
- Seed prompts: attached is an edited prompt set (bentwood-prompt-set.csv) with our most common user flows — there are ~1.2k unique prompts. Please respect prompt order and frequencies in column 'weight'.
- Cache behavior: our integration uses a short-lived per-user KV cache. We expect some first-request penalties; please capture cache-hit ratio in the artifacts.
- Dedicated vs hosted: we requested a dedicated slice to mirror production; please confirm the slice id and whether the test will run on quantized runtime.

One ask from our infra team: can you include the raw request IDs for requests that hit p99 so we can cross-reference with our logs? We'll also require the run artifacts uploaded to the Drive folder (link in previous mail).

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Park
Product Ops, Bentwood Labs
olivia@bentwood.ai

Attachment: bentwood-prompt-set.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bentwood benchmarking kickoff: test plan and targets

Hi Olivia — quick run summary below from the 2028-03-29 02:00-05:00 UTC execution. Raw artifacts are at: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/bentwood/run-20280329 (CSV + histograms). Attached: bentwood-run-20280329-1.csv (aggregated per-minute metrics).

Run highlights (measurement window 02:20-04:40 UTC):
- Sustained throughput: 118 RPS (target 100-120 RPS)
- Latency (256->64 tokens): p50 = 85 ms, p95 = 210 ms, p99 = 680 ms
- Error rate (5xx): 0.12% (largely transient 429s during the 03:15 spike)
- KV cache hit ratio: 72% overall; initial 10-minute window shows lower hits (avg 40%) as expected
- CPU/GPU: average GPU utilization per-instance 58%, some instances spiked to 92% during 03:14-03:16 UTC when a traffic burst replayed

Observations & action items:
1) p95 is slightly over the target (210 ms vs 200 ms) and p99 is above the stated acceptance threshold (680 ms vs 600 ms). The p99 appears correlated with cold-cache misses and a short-lived request-burst that caused CPU contention on two worker instances.
2) We recommend a short burst-protection policy (token-bucket smoothing) and 2-minute pre-warm on hot user cohorts to mitigate cold-start tail.
3) For Bentwood to accept onboarding now vs require a remediation sprint, we propose two options: 
   A) Accept with conditional SLAs: immediate launch with an ops runbook (we'll set automated fallback to a cheaper model variant if p99>750 ms) and a 2-week remediation plan to bring p99 <= 600 ms.
   B) Require remediation before sign-off: schedule 1-week focused perf sprint (Redwood infra + Bentwood infra) to chase down KV misses and instance sizing optimizations.

Next steps: please confirm which option you prefer. If you accept A, we'll prepare the ops runbook + automated fallback policy. If you prefer B, we'll propose a sprint plan and dates.

Best,
Monica
Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: bentwood-run-20280329-1.csv

Ben / Monica / team — thanks for the thorough execution and the artifact bundle. We reviewed the CSV and histograms with our infra lead this morning. Two quick decisions from Bentwood leadership: 

1) We will accept the onboarding under conditional SLA (option A from Monica) to avoid delaying our Q2 feature release. Acceptance criteria: 
   - Immediate go-live with the opt-in cohort (10% traffic) and automated fallback to rwd-medium if p99 exceeds 750 ms for more than 3 consecutive minutes.
   - Redwood to deliver remediation plan with milestones to reach p99 <= 600 ms across 90% of windows, timeline: 14 calendar days starting Mon, Apr 2 2028.

2) Please provide a DocuSign addendum to the onboarding statement reflecting the conditional SLA and remediation milestones. We'll countersign.

Ben — can you create the DocuSign and share the link? Monica / Infra, please coordinate the remediation sprint plan and diagnostics (we'll need the per-request IDs for p99 as Olivia requested).

Thanks,
